activities.name: Galápagos wildlife
activities.note: the islands have no closed season and the animals do not migrate away — what changes is which species is doing what

windows.reason: the cool, dry season: the Humboldt Current brings nutrient-rich water and with it whale sharks, hammerheads and dolphins, plus migratory birds

activities.name: Humpback whales off the Pacific coast
activities.note: the whales are in Antarctic waters the rest of the year

windows.reason: peak months, with sighting success rates around 95%
humpbacks migrate up from Antarctica to breed off the Ecuadorian coast between June and September
